decision.rationale: M389's 14-file output manifest, second seal, exact runner/TCL/contract, M387 r1b inputs and M388 admission all verify. Raw Formality evidence reports Verification SUCCEEDED with 1963 passing points = 793 ports + 1170 DFFs and zero failing, aborted, unverified or unmatched compare points. The repeated 375-cell warning concerns missing low-power power-down metadata in the technology library under an always-powered, no-UPF/CPF run; it created no black-box/cut compare point and did not damage equivalence. Prelayout PT STA may proceed, but PTPX remains blocked because no SAIF/VCD/FSDB activity evidence exists.

power_cell_warning_disposition.raw_message_scope: unlinked power cells with no power down function on an ff or latch
basis: Both reference and implementation tops linked successfully
The run supplied no UPF or CPF and proved the always-powered functional model
BBPin, Loop, BBNet, Cut and LAT passing categories are all zero
All 793 port and 1170 DFF compare points pass
Failing, aborted, unverified and unmatched compare reports are all empty
power_cell_warning_disposition.restriction: This warning cannot be used as low-power intent, power-state or PTPX evidence.

findings.title: Technology library lacks power-down metadata for 375 power cells
findings.detail: Formality emits the warning once while elaborating each container. It is benign for this always-powered equivalence proof but blocks any inference about isolation, retention or powered-down behavior.

findings.title: Fifty-six reference unread points are optimized non-endpoints
findings.detail: Raw matching lists 56 reference and zero implementation unread points, while unmatched compare points and unmatched primary-input/black-box-output points are both zero. They are not compare endpoints and do not weaken the 1963-point proof, but should remain visible in signoff records.

findings.title: SVF has no guide_hier_map command and the parameter guard initial is ignored
findings.detail: All 227 available SVF commands are accepted with zero rejection/unsupported/unprocessed, and verification completes. Formality also warns that the inactive FIFO_DEPTH!=8 initial fatal is unsupported. Exact FIFO_DEPTH=8 identity and the flat single-controller proof make these non-blocking here.

findings.title: PrimeTime admission remains explicitly prelayout
findings.detail: Equivalence proves function, not timing. M387 r1b remains ideal-clock, ZeroWireload and hold-delay-cell dominated, without clock tree, parasitics or descriptor/PWP SRAM macros. PT STA must retain those boundaries.

findings.title: PTPX remains blocked by absent workload activity
findings.detail: Independent scanning finds no SAIF, VCD or FSDB in the exact M384 r1b VCS, M387 r1b or M389 evidence. Formal equivalence cannot substitute for mapped activity and annotation coverage.

next_admission.prelayout_ptsta: GO against the exact M387 r1b mapped Verilog/SDC with explicit ideal-clock, no-parasitic, no-SRAM wording
next_admission.ptpx: NO-GO until exact-SHA workload SAIF and mapped-name/annotation coverage are sealed
